item.name: Customer Registration - Init
item.description: Step 1/3: Initiate customer registration by sending phone number and basic details (firstName, lastName, password). Password is hashed and stored in Redis session. OTP will be sent via WhatsApp.

item.name: Customer Registration - Verify Phone
item.description: Step 2/3: Verify phone number using the OTP received via WhatsApp.

item.name: Customer Registration - Complete
item.description: Step 3/3: Complete registration with profile details. firstName, lastName, password, and email are optional (read from Redis session if omitted). Account is automatically verified (phone was verified in step 2).
